## Why
The root of track B (`docs/local-first.md` §10). Its children put the runtime seam under the tick, make the clocks pause-aware and sleep-aware, and add `start`/`pause`/`resume`/`stop` at worker and board level, `hkb ps`, and the live web board. This card is the verify-and-synthesize pass once B5 and B6 are done.

## What
Do not redo the children's work; read their results (`hkb show <n> --json` on B1–B6; B5 and B6 are your blockers, name the others by number). Then:
1. On a scratch local board with the `claude-p` profile (or manual attempts): `start <n>`, `pause <n>`, `resume <n>`, `stop <n>`, `start <n>` again (warm), then the board-level four and `ps`, recording each command and what `hkb show` said after it.
2. Check the pieces fit: a paused attempt is never reclaimed at any clock value; a stopped card with an open PR stays claimable; the reap stops a parked job.
3. Write what no child could: `docs/wiki/concepts/control-plane.md` (the mapping, the verbs, "a pause lives on its object"), `features/runtime-seam.md`, refresh `features/web-board.md`; `skills/kanban/references/protocol.md` gains the `stopped` outcome and the ⏸ overlay in the state machine; a CHANGELOG entry.
4. `npm run lint && npm test && npm run smoke`.

## Done when
- [ ] The walk-through of step 1 is in this card's result with exact commands.
- [ ] The three wiki pages exist/are refreshed and `wiki-check` reports nothing stale for track B's pages.
- [ ] `npm test` and `npm run smoke` green.

**Read first:** `docs/local-first.md` (the plan; the sections named below), `docs/wiki/decisions/adr-005-control-plane.md`,
`docs/wiki/decisions/adr-006-local-store.md`, `CLAUDE.md`. Keep it dependency-free at runtime. Pure logic in
`src/model.js` with a test. Errors name the fix and carry `.exitCode`. `--json` everywhere. Update the wiki page a
change touches (`node .repolore/scripts/wiki-check.mjs` lists what went stale); a new feature gets a new page.
Finish with `npm run lint && npm test` green, one draft PR, and exactly one terminal verb.
goal: every verb of docs/local-first.md §3 exercised on a scratch local board; wiki pages for the verbs, the runtime seam and the live web board; npm test and smoke green
title: Local-first hkb, track B: the control plane verbs on the store
